ITEM 1 | White, opaque, flaky chunks with slightly irregular edges and small dark speckles (seasoning), moist-looking, mostly holding shape, clustered on the left-center of the plate; pieces about 2-3 cm across, roughly 1-1.5 cm thick | 110
ITEM 2 | Round, brown-grey patties about 2 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick, matte surface with slight browning and fine texture, four pieces scattered at the bottom-center of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Bright orange cubes about 1 cm, matte with slightly soft edges, some with light browning, scattered among the other foods near the center and lower-left | 25
ITEM 4 | Yellow pineapple-like chunks, about 2-3 cm, glossy and moist with light golden caramelized edges, cut into irregular wedges and cubes, clustered on the right side of the plate | 150
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellow-tan cubes and bits with slightly darker browned edges, firm and matte, scattered among the other items | 15
ITEM 6 | Dark brown, cylindrical pieces about 1.5-2 cm long with browned, slightly glossy surface and roasted edges, a few pieces near the center | 20
